findings.message:
[P2] Branch previews still report the legacy router URL

Following the new template only forwards `preview_project`, while the reusable workflow still hardcodes its preview `router_url` to `https://preview-${base}.ubq.fi` (`deno-deploy-reusable.yml:1497`). A `feat/widget` deployment is therefore summarized with the legacy shared-preview host instead of the new branch host, and previews for the root `ubq-fi` project receive no router URL at all, so the branch-prefix URL implemented here is not surfaced. Update the URL calculation to derive the host from the resolved preview project when one is supplied.

README.md:65-65

summary: The branch-preview helper implements deterministic per-branch projects and deletion cleanup, but the integration still reports the legacy preview router URL rather than the branch-specific host.

evidence: `previewProject` derives a deterministic DNS-safe project name from the production project and exact branch, preserving slash, dash, and case variants through an eight-character hash and clamping names to 26 characters.
`branchTarget` resolves push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch, and workflow_run source branches, and marks both delete events and deleted push events for cleanup.
`deletePreview` deletes the generated project through the Classic API or the Deno 2 SDK, and the README template passes the generated preview project into the reusable deployment workflow.
